title: 我开源了一套 Skill + CLI，让 Codex 帮我一步通关 iOS App Store 上架
summary: 小Y documents a Codex release workflow that compares an IPA, a delivery manifest, and App Store Connect before proposing changes for approval. An iOS team can validate localized fields, apply a reviewed plan, and read remote state back after writes; the reported Stikumi update covers 50 locales and 228 screenshots, while a fully automated new-app setup remains untested.
takeaway: Start with a read-only version/build audit, review field and screenshot differences before applying them, then read every changed remote value back; retain human release approval.
